RingbitCar.back: Moves at full speed. It may drift slightly.
RingbitCar.forward: Moves at full speed. It may drift slightly.
RingbitCar.steering_angle: Turns about the set angle. Actual angle may vary slightly.
RingbitCar.steering_angle|param|angle: angle to turn in degrees, eg: 90
RingbitCar.running_distance: Moves about the set distance. Actual distance may vary slightly.
RingbitCar.running_distance|param|distan: distance to move in centimeters, eg: 10
